name: Daulet Malm-Amoah
role: Electronic and physical observation expert — surveillance specialist
location: Steamvent Alley — geothermal district, hot and chemical-smelling, near Fullerton and Damen
description:
Daulet Malm-Amoah is tall and rawboned, the kind of frame that suggests either malnutrition or efficiency depending on the decade. At 29, her expression defaults to a careful neutrality that took years of practice to maintain. The chrome is visible — cranial bomb defuser — specialized implant that detects and neutralizes cortex b — and she makes no effort to hide it.

She arrived in GLMZ six years ago with nothing but chrome and debts, and has been working off both ever since. She works as a surveillance specialist out of Steamvent Alley, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Daulet Malm-Amoah has survived long enough in the runner game to be either very good or very lucky, and she cultivates ambiguity on the topic.

core_fears: Being identified by corporate facial recognition — living off-grid is survival
Going cyberpsycho — losing the boundary between human and machine
That their reputation is built on luck, not skill, and the luck is finite
core_desires: To build something that outlasts the next contract cycle
Power — enough leverage that nobody ever threatens them again
Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
coping_mechanisms: Art — draws, paints, or sculpts in private; the violence goes somewhere constructive
Maintains weapons obsessively — cleaning guns is meditation
Ritual — follows the same pre-job routine every time, superstition as structure
blind_spots: Cannot distinguish between caution and cowardice in themselves or others
Cannot see that their independence is actually isolation wearing a better outfit
Fails to notice when their own behavior mirrors the people they despise
psychology.secret: Daulet Malm-Amoah has a child in another city, being raised by someone else. Sends Φ2,000 monthly under an alias. Has never visited.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Old-fashioned formal diction — sounds like they learned to speak from pre-collapse recordings.
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured and deliberate — pauses before important words for emphasis.
verbal_tics: Calls everyone 'friend' — the warmth varies from genuine to threatening
Calls money 'weight' — as in 'that job doesn't carry enough weight'
example_lines: "I've been watching you for three days. You should close your curtains."
"Information is the only commodity that appreciates with age."
"Everyone thinks they're careful. Nobody is careful enough."

story_hooks: A crew member from Daulet Malm-Amoah's past shows up in GLMZ, carrying old grievances and new chrome
A Tier 4 executive offers Daulet Malm-Amoah a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
Someone is impersonating Daulet Malm-Amoah on jobs, and the impersonator is better at the work than the original
narrative_function: Daulet Malm-Amoah functions as a connector — her work puts her in contact with multiple factions, classes, and agendas. Stories involving her naturally cross boundaries between districts, tiers, and moral categories.
augmentations: Cranial bomb defuser — specialized implant that detects and neutralizes cortex bombs in others. Dermal camouflage — chromatic skin pigment cells, limited active camouflage
daily_life: Keeps a rigid daily structure — wake, train, check contracts, maintain gear, sleep. The structure is a defense against the chaos of the work. Deviations from the schedule are a warning sign that something is wrong.

weaknesses: augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions

decision_rules: Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Competitive but reliable. Will challenge decisions but never abandon the team.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Despises corporate culture but has unconsciously adopted its efficiency metrics and self-optimization language
Values loyalty intensely but has betrayed someone in the past to survive
habits: Wears the same item of clothing for luck — a scarf, a glove, a specific pair of boots
Keeps a physical paper notebook — no digital record of personal thoughts
Carries a specific caliber round as a lucky charm — has never fired it
breaking_points: Running out of options — no contacts, no money, no safe house, no way out
Their body rejecting their cyberware — chrome rot, immune rejection, the nightmare scenario

physical_description.build: Rawboned and lean — minimal subcutaneous fat, defined musculature from consistent training. The kind of frame that reads as either disciplined or half-starved depending on the light. Long-limbed and efficient.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown, almost black, with a faint metallic sheen from mineral deposits in Steamvent water
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, utilitarian braid that exposes the cranial implant
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with subtle chromatic shift at the edges — side effect of dermal camouflage neural integration
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium brown with warm undertones, displaying uneven pigmentation in patches across shoulders and forearms where dermal camouflage cells are concentrated
physical_description.complexion: Sharp cheekbones, angular jaw, minimal facial hair. Skin is weathered but well-maintained — scars are few but deliberately unhidden. No cosmetic grooming; everything functional.
distinguishing_marks: Cranial bomb defuser implant visible along right temple — a thin line of chrome running from temple to occipital ridge, with a small circular access port behind the right ear
Thin scar running down the left side of her neck, approximately 8cm, likely from bladed trauma
Chromatic skin patches across both shoulders and upper forearms in irregular patterns — areas of active dermal camouflage integration that shift subtly in certain light
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Cranial bomb defuser implant is prominently visible along the right side of her skull with chrome detailing and an access port. Dermal camouflage creates irregular pigmentation variations across shoulders and forearms that shift slightly under different lighting — noticeable but not grotesque. No effort made to conceal either.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical and controlled — every movement serves a purpose. She stands with weight balanced, shoulders back, ready to move in any direction. Her gaze is constant and assessing. She moves with the precision of someone trained to enter and exit spaces without leaving traces.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 working specialist aesthetic. Black or dark gray reinforced tactical pants with utility pockets and cable routing. Loose-fit thermal undershirt. Lightweight ballistic vest with custom modifications for surveillance work — no unnecessary branding, matte finish to avoid reflection. Worn cargo jacket with multiple hidden pockets and signal-blocking lining. Pair of worn boots with reinforced soles, good for urban climbing. Everything is functional, well-maintained, and color-coordinated for Steamvent's industrial backdrop.
